rationale: Current /health proves HTTP/liveness only. It must not certify authenticated command, SQLite authority, coordinator fence, project freshness, Nexus or Telegram.

current_gap.evidence: windows/bcp_server.py /health currently returns ok=true for process/HTTP liveness; Android BcpClient.quick acceptance reads this before deeper authenticated checks.
current_gap.reason_not_hotpatched: Changing windows/bcp_server.py would change the qualified 0.6.4 payload hash without a coordinated version/release update and could violate anti-downgrade/release identity invariants.
required_next_release_patch: Expose authenticated bounded health vector at diagnostics/acceptance boundary.
Prove SQLite authority writer availability without persistent health-test mutation.
Require command path + authority + revision/fence + identity freshness before END_TO_END_HEALTHY.
Keep Nexus/Telegram failures as independent degraded dimensions; never demote functioning local core to dead.
Add Android acceptance regression and coordinated server/edge compatibility test.

promotion_rule: BCP END_TO_END_HEALTHY is a vector-derived state. /health alone can only prove SERVER_PROCESS_AND_HTTP_LIVENESS.
